blocks.text: If you ask most children what their favorite treat is, they will answer “Ice cream!” There is nothing like delicious ice-cream cone on a hot, summer day. Every year Americans eat more than four billion ice-cream cones. Did you know that the ice-cream cone was invented by accident? St. Louis was having a world’s fair in 1904. Ice cream was a big seller. One person selling ice-cream ran out of dishes and did’t know what to do. Luckily, a person nearby, who was selling waffles, suggested rolling a waffle and putting the ice-cream inside. It was an instant success.

readingSentences.english: Laughter is a powerful antidote to stress, pain, and conflict.
readingSentences.korean: 웃음은 스트레스와 고통, 그리고 갈등에 대한 강력한 해독제이다.

readingSentences.english: Sharing humor binds people together and creates instant camaraderie.
readingSentences.korean: 유머를 함께 나누는 것은 사람들을 하나로 묶어주고 즉각적인 유대감을 형성한다.

readingSentences.english: Physiologically, laughter relaxes muscles, lowers blood pressure, and boosts immunity.
readingSentences.korean: 생리학적으로 웃음은 근육을 이완시키고 혈압을 낮추며 면역력을 증강시킨다.

readingSentences.english: A cheerful spirit makes heavy burdens light and keeps the heart resilient.
readingSentences.korean: 밝고 유쾌한 마음은 무거운 짐을 가볍게 만들고 마음을 늘 탄력 있게 유지시켜 준다.
